title: MAG-04 · The darija of the media and the darija written

blocks.text: MAG-04 · The darija of the media and the darija written
Lesson overview

Last unit of the Moroccan track. Luca is back in Milan, but the darija follows him: the Moroccan radio that listens online, the videos that Hind sends him, the messages of Karīm, advertising and signs in holiday photos. In this unit you learn to understand the darija of the media (radio broadcasts with online listeners, advertising, videos) and especially the written darija, which meets in two forms: Arabic characters (advertising, social networks, some sites) and Latin characters with figures, such as Egyptian Arabic (ARZ-01, ARZ-02) but with own habits, influenced by French. You also learn how to orient yourself in multilingual signs (Arabic, Amazigh, French). Finally find the profile of the MAG track. Five weeks, in parallel with the Test B2.4 and B2-24.

rows: 7–8 hours · five weeks (weeks 248–252), about 1,5 hours per week in two blocks

blocks.text: Materials This unit, a Moroccan speaker for scripts, radio broadcasts and Moroccan public videos chosen by the tutor
Targets. At the end of the unit you know:
1. follow broad lines a radio broadcast in darija with speeches by the listeners;
2. read short texts in darija in Arabic characters (advertising, messages, posts);
3. read darija messages in Latin characters with digits, and their conventions to the French version of the text;
4. recognizing the languages of Moroccan cartels (Arabic, Amazigh, French);
5. evaluate your understanding profile of the Moroccan at the end B2.
Five-week plan (two blocks from 40–45 minutes per week).

rows: Sections 2 and 3: media, darija in Arabic characters · exercises 1 and 2

3. The darija in Arabic characters
When darija is written in Arabic characters, it partly follows the habits of fuṣḥā and in part the pronunciation:
Denial ⁧ماشي مزيان⁩ · ⁧ما كنفهمش⁩ But...š joined to the verb
reduced vowels ⁧بزاف⁩ · ( ktəb) ⁧كتب⁩ short vowels do not write
Advertising and slogans (invented). « ⁧ديما معاك⁩ Always with you. ⁧شري دابا وخلص من بعد⁩ Buy now, pay later. ⁧زيد شحن، زيد ربح⁩ • more reloads, more wins.
4. The darija in Latin characters
In chat and social media, darija is often written in Latin characters, with figures for the sounds that French does not have: he is the Moroccan cousin of Egyptian Arabic (ARZ-01).

Differences from Egyptian Arabic. In the Maghreb a lot of ch (non sh), ou (not u) and j ž, because the school teaches French; the digit 9 for ⁧ق⁩ is very frequent (in Egypt the ⁧ق⁩ is often ʾ and it's written 2); 5 for ⁧خ⁩ It is rare: you prefer kh.

6. The languages of the cartels

In Morocco Arabic and amazigh are the official languages (the amazigh from 2011); French is widely used in administration, economy and higher education; In the north you can also hear Spanish. On official signs you often find three scriptures:

rows: Arabic alphabet, from right to left
alphabet tifinagh: geometric signs (circles, crosses, lines, points), from left to right
the name of the institution in amazigh

blocks.text: French Latin alphabet École · Hôpital · Wilaya

You don't need to read the tifinagh at this level: just recognize it and know that it is the official writing of the amazigh. The names of the places can appear in three different forms (e.g. the Arabic name of a city, the Amazigh and the French).
